dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: The study uses a large multi-site dataset for normative model training and evaluation. For functional models (Supp1): ABCD (21 sites), AOMIC (2 sites), CAMCAN, CMI-HBN (2 sites), CNP (2 sites), HCP-A (4 sites), HCP-D (4 sites), HCP-YA, NKI-RS, PNC, UK Biobank, plus an additional NKI site totaling 41 sites. For structural cortical thickness models: pre-trained on ~58,000 subjects from Rutherford et al. 2022a (individual site details not provided in this paper). For surface area models (Supp2): ABCD (22 sites), ATT, ATV, CAMCAN, CIN, CMI (2 sites), CNP (2 sites), COI, OpenNeuro datasets (ds001734, ds002236, ds002330, ds002345, ds002731, ds002837), HCP-Aging (4 sites), HCP-Dev (4 sites), HCP-EP (4 sites), HCP-YA, HKH, HRC, HUH, IXI, KTT, KUT, NKI, NKN, OASIS-3, PNC, SWA, SWU_SLIM, TOP, UK Biobank (3 sites) totaling 66 sites. For benchmarking: HCP-YA, COBRE, UMich. MULTI-DATASET category applies because N>=10 distinct datasets are used across functional and structural models.

dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.detail: The functional normative models were trained/tested (80/20 split stratified by site) on data from 41 sites. The structural cortical thickness and subcortical volume normative models were pre-trained on ~58,000 subjects from Rutherford et al. 2022a (specific datasets not detailed here). Surface area models were trained on a similar but distinct dataset (~43,000 subjects from 66 sites, Supp2). For benchmarking: HCP-YA was used for regression (predicting general cognitive ability), while COBRE and UMich were used as transfer sets for classification (SZ vs HC) and group difference testing. HCP-YA was included in the initial functional model training (half held out in test set), while UMich and COBRE were not included in training.

model-1.model-name: structural cortical thickness and subcortical volume model (pre-trained from Rutherford 2022a)

dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.detail: Model-1 (structural): Pre-trained cortical thickness and subcortical volume models from Rutherford et al. 2022a estimated on approximately 58,000 subjects using warped Bayesian Linear Regression; the train/test split details are not reported in this paper. Model-2 (functional): Trained on data from 41 sites with 80/20 train/test split stratified by site. Train N=14,708, Test N=7,180, Overall N=21,888 (computed by summing all sites in Supplementary file 1). Training excluded subjects with any known psychiatric diagnosis. Model-3 (surface area): Data from 66 sites described in Supplementary file 2, total N=43,146 (computed by summing all sites); train/test split not separately specified in the supplement.

dc_4_age_info_of_each_normative_nodel.detail: Model-1 (structural, from Rutherford 2022a): The paper mentions these models chart lifespan trajectories 'ages 2-100'; per-subject demographics are not reported in this paper. Model-2 (functional): Weighted mean age and pooled SD were computed from per-site statistics in Supplementary file 1 across all 41 sites (Train: sum(Ni*meani)/N_total; Pooled SD: sqrt(sum(Ni*sdi^2)/N_total)). Age range inferred from youngest sites (ABCD, mean ~10, sd ~0.6, min ~9) and oldest sites (UK Biobank, mean ~63, sd ~7.5, max ~80). Model-3 (surface area): Weighted mean age and pooled SD computed from Supplementary file 2 across 66 sites. Age range inferred from CMI sites (youngest, mean ~10) and OASIS-3/UK Biobank (oldest, mean ~70).

dc_5_sex_info_of_each_normative_nodel.detail: Model-1 (structural, from Rutherford 2022a): Sex distribution not reported in this paper as structural models come from a prior publication. Model-2 (functional): Sex counts computed from Supplementary file 1 by applying F/M percentages to N for each site then summing across all sites. Note: percentages for some test sites do not sum to 100% (e.g., ABCD_12 test: 1.47%F/54.41%M; ABCD_16 test: 42.64%F/48.7%M), likely reflecting data entry errors in the supplement. These were included as-is. Overall female+male sums to approximately 21,808 rather than 21,888 due to these percentage discrepancies, giving slightly approximate values. Model-3 (surface area): Computed from Supplementary file 2 similarly. Train/test split not available for model-3 as the supplement does not distinguish train vs test.
